connector.name: Clipform
connector.registryDescription: Interactive video forms that capture authentic responses. Build engaging forms in minutes.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.clipform.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the clipform account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CLIPFORM_API_KEY
env.description: API key that scopes tool calls to your workspace (create one in the dashboard under Settings, API keys). Not needed to list tools, only to call them.
